SR006-BR-001.description: Mixed siblings: the history surface shows the universal Team status; the running surface keeps binary activity

historyGroup.title: Team status: Error
historyGroup.innerClass: inline-block h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-red-500

historyActiveRun.title: Team status: Error
historyActiveRun.innerClass: inline-block h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-red-500

historyInactiveRun.title: Team status: Offline
historyInactiveRun.innerClass: inline-block h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gray-400

runningGroup.title: Active team runs
runningGroup.className: h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-blue-500 mr-1.5

SR006-BR-002.description: Collapsed history group follows member status (not representative or Stop state); running surface stays binary

history.title: Team status: Error
history.innerClass: inline-block h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-red-500

running.title: Active team runs
running.className: h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-blue-500 mr-1.5

history.title: Team status: Running
history.innerClass: inline-block h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-blue-500 animate-pulse

running.title: Active team runs
running.className: h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-blue-500 mr-1.5

history.title: Team status: Running
history.innerClass: inline-block h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-blue-500 animate-pulse

running.title: Active team runs
running.className: h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-blue-500 mr-1.5

SR006-BR-003.description: Final active-to-inactive transition updates collapsed parents and exact run rows

history.title: Team status: Offline
history.innerClass: inline-block h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gray-400

running.title: No active team runs
running.className: h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gray-400 mr-1.5

historyFormerActive.title: Team status: Offline
historyFormerActive.innerClass: inline-block h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gray-400

historyInactive.title: Team status: Offline
historyInactive.innerClass: inline-block h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gray-400

SR006-BR-004.description: English and Simplified Chinese catalogs provide the accessible Team status and binary running-surface meaning

historyGroup.title: 团队状态：离线
historyGroup.innerClass: inline-block h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gray-400

historyFormerActive.title: 团队状态：离线
historyFormerActive.innerClass: inline-block h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gray-400

runningGroup.title: 无活跃团队运行
runningGroup.className: h-2 w-2 flex-shrink-0 rounded-full bg-gray-400 mr-1.5
